<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex021032025-12-0316-33-34" status="unreviewed">de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3829">dge bshes pu to ba</rs> na re |
       <lb n="31b5"/> zab pa ni don dam pa yin te rtogs par dka' bas so || 
       rgya che ba ni kun rdzob yin te | chos can mang bas so || 
       yangs pa ni don dam pa yin te | ngos gzung med pas so || 
       dog pa ni kun rdzob yin te | chos can so so rta lasogs pa
       <lb n="31b6"/> pa bsgyur du mi btub pas gsung ngo || </seg></TEI>
